entries.notes: Selected the single reported TAS-20 CFA solution for the total adolescent sample. F1 maps to Difficulty Identifying Feelings (DIF), F2 to Difficulty Describing Feelings (DDF), and F3 to Externally Oriented Thinking (EOT), following the printed order in Table 1. Only one loading per item was reported in the CFA table; all unreported item-factor relations were coded null. Factor correlations were taken from the same Table 1. Estimation method was not explicitly reported beyond CFA conducted in SPSS Amos, so met is null. The paper reports n = 225 for the cohort and total TAS-20 score, while some subscale descriptive rows show larger item-level ns; n = 225 was used for the analyzed sample.
